Global keydown logic in Music ignores events when target is BUTTON/INPUT/TEXTAREA, which suppresses documented D/B shortcut flow after clicking pads.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop + mobile(390) + tablet(768) flows validated. Backend SSE stories validated for EN+BN via pytest. Download artifacts saved in /app/test_reports. Recheck only keyboard D/B-after-focus behavior and optional Three.js warning cleanup.
rca of the issue: Music keyboard shortcut issue RCA: in frontend/src/pages/Music.jsx, window keydown handler exits when event.target.tagName is BUTTON/INPUT/TEXTAREA. After a user clicks a sound pad button, focus remains on BUTTON, so subsequent KeyD/KeyB presses are ignored and beat counter does not update. Mitigation: either remove BUTTON from this guard or conditionally bypass guard for D/B shortcuts.
